fact: The ministry (MASFAMU) says the modernisation and expansion phase of the Cadastro Social Único, launched 20 July 2026, promotes interoperability between public institutions and integration of databases.

MASFAMU launched the Cadastro Social Único on 20 July 2026 and says it will allow articulation between social programmes, local administration, civil registries, public institutions and sectoral databases.
The World Bank status report says work on integrating Kwenda programme data with other systems and programmes in the country, named as MASFAMU's SIGAS, had advanced well by 30 June 2024.
The World Bank status report says the Cadastro Social Unico (CSU) was not operational at 30 June 2024, so the project counted units with access to the MASFAMU SIGAS registry instead (54 of 54 CASIs).

The record, citing the World Bank status report of 25 October 2024, says the Cadastro Social Unico was still not operational as of mid-2024 and MASFAMU's SIGAS registry was available in all 54 CASIs in its place.
